title: Memory Match
short_description: Flip cards, find the pairs, train your memory
long_description:
Memory Match is a self-contained single-page HTML5 game from the Omega Games library. Flip cards to find matching pairs. Pure memory training.

Controls: tap/click. No installation, no account, no external network calls — the whole game is one HTML file that runs entirely in the browser tab it's loaded in.

It's a puzzle title: think first, then act — there's no time pressure forcing a wrong move.

Built for embedding: the page has no iframe-blocking headers, so it drops straight into a portal frame at any size. Session length is short (seconds to a few minutes per round), which fits browsing/portal traffic patterns rather than a long-form download.

Source id: memory_match. Part of a 21-title batch of small HTML5 games being submitted from the same library — if you like this one, the others share the same lightweight, dependency-free build.
cover_capture_method: playwright chromium headless, local file:// build
